title: Toronto's Waterfront: a Smartphone Audio Walking Tour
blurb:
Listen to a tour guide through your smartphone as you explore Toronto's incredible waterfront!

On this 4.5 km sightseeing tour, you'll discover incredible views, buildings, tourist attractions, statues & urban parks.

Highlights include the CN tower, Rogers Centre, Sugar Beach, Princes' Gates, Toronto's Music Garden, One Yonge Street + more! Don't just see Toronto's waterfront, hear what it has to say!

GPS map shows where you are and where to go next. As you get close, tour guide commentary will automatically play.

The tour also comes with a fun location based trivia game. After the commentary plays, look at your device and tap your answer.

Keep the professional tour guide experience, ditch crowded tour groups, tight schedules & high prices.

Enjoy anytime, not just on your booking date. Stop & start anywhere along route.

The number of travelers you select is the number of devices you can download the tour to. 

Trust the platform with over 75 tours & 25,000+ happy customers.
